Interface MessageVisitor

All Known Implementing Classes:
BaseTUIController, GameController, LobbyController, LobbyController, NetworkSetupController, PreLobbyController, PreLobbyController, ViewGameController
public interface MessageVisitor
Visitor for handling ServerMessages on the client side, with one visit overload per concrete message type. A message dispatches itself here through its ServerMessage.accept(MessageVisitor) method.

Every overload has an empty default body, so a client only needs to override the messages it actually cares about; unhandled message types are silently ignored.
